findings.claim: draft-gap-closing-activity succeeded at 10:05Z (282s) but produced zero new templates: template count remains 28 with no additions after 09:40Z, meaning the ribosome did not extract a new template from the successful execution

evidence.excerpt: Templates created after 09:40Z: 0. Template count: 28 (unchanged from investigation-016). draft-gap-closing-activity at 10:05Z (success, 282s) did not seed new templates.

evidence.command: docker exec substrate-live systemctl list-units | grep ribosome
evidence.excerpt: ribosome-vessel.service loaded active running. Ribosome subscribes to lifecycle:execution:succeeded events via WebSocket. Whether the 10:05Z draft-gap-closing success triggered ribosome extraction depends on output shapes — if the trace had no output_shapes field, ribosome would not extract.

findings.operator_remediation: Ribosome extraction requires output_shapes on the trace OR a non-empty output_impulse_ids on tasks. If draft-gap-closing-activity produced no output impulses with extractable shapes, ribosome would have nothing to extract. Verify the execution detail for task output_impulse_ids.
